name: Periciazine
aliases: Propericiazine, Periciazina, Periciazinum, pericyazine, Pericyazine, Piperocyanomazine, propericiazine, RP-8909
summary: Periciazine (INN), also known as pericyazine (BAN) or propericiazine, is a drug that belongs to the phenothiazine class of typical antipsychotics.
